component: VexRiscv RV32IMA 'linux' CPU RTL: MMU, 2 KiB I-cache / 2 KiB D-cache, no FPU, single-cycle shift and mul/div

source.command: runMain vexriscv.GenCoreDefault --csrPluginConfig linux --iCacheSize 2048 --dCacheSize 2048 --singleCycleMulDiv true --singleCycleShift true --fpu false --compressedGen false --outputFile VexRiscv_Mmu
source.note: Only the selected production variant is committed as VexRiscv_Mmu.v. Regenerate with mini.py build cpu --generate --vendor-dir gateware/vendor/vexriscv; the tool refuses to overwrite differing bytes unless --force is given.

VexRiscv_Mmu.yaml.note: VexRiscv iBus BusReport (32-byte lines, 2048-byte cache), consumed by LiteX when the external variant is used
